text:
kai: Heads up — CI perf jobs for branch release/v0.43 show 20-30% p99 increase on short-sequence chat workload after libtriton bumped to 1.2.0.
ci-bench-bot: New benchmark run: https://ci.redwood/bench/178425 — p95 +12%, p99 +28%, throughput -18%.
omar: ack. can you paste the perf diffs and the failing CI job id?
kai: job 178425. Quick reproduce command:
```
./bench/run.sh --model llama-7b --seq 32 --threads 8 --triton-lib=1.2.0
```
Profile shows triton selecting 'matmul_generic_small' instead of 'matmul_fused_128' for head dim 64. NVTX snapshot:
```
kernel: matmul_generic_small  time: 1.8ms  occupancy 45%
kernel: matmul_fused_128   time: 0.42ms occupancy 86%
```
leigh: that's huge. why did selector pick generic? we changed kernel-ranking heuristics in triton 1.2 (heuristic_thresholds.json) — smaller matmuls map to generic with recent heuristics.
sara: also seeing more KV cache misses in the same runs. small batch sizes + this kernel change increases latency variance; KV cache eviction metric spiked.
omar: can we bisect to the exact commit that triggered the change? try replacing triton.so from 1.1.3 and rerun.
kai: did that — swapping back to 1.1.3 restores perf: p99 back to baseline, throughput +16%. Created a bisect note: suspect commit 7f3b4c in triton repo (kernel ranking tweak).
kai: gist of profiler artifacts: https://stash/infra/profiles/178425
deploy-bot: Canary blocked: rollout/v0.43 halted by perf regression guardrail (p99 > +15%).
sara: I'm opening a hotfix PR to pin triton to 1.1.3 in our deps and revert the runtime change that allowed fallback to matmul_generic_small for head_dim=64.
omar: please include CI perf numbers in PR description. we need +bench screenshots.
kai: PR: https://gh.redwood/inference/pull/3210 — includes revert + pin. bench run attached: p99 delta -25% vs bad build.
leigh: can we add a quick heuristic patch: if head_dim in (32,64) prefer fused kernel until we validate triton heuristics upstream?
sara: yes, adding a runtime override flag `--prefer-fused-matmul` and enabling it in canary.
deploy-bot: Canary unblocked — revert merged (PR 3210). Rollout resumed.
omar: follow-up: open an issue against Triton with reproducer + perf profile, assign to runtime team to coordinate upstream fix.
kai: created issue https://gh.triton/issues/4321 and linked the profiler. tagging @triton-eng.
leigh: nice work. keep an eye on KV cache stats during next canary.
sara: noted, will watch dashboards and add alert for KV eviction > 5%.
kai: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
